commitMessage: DEV-23: Build deterministic execution intelligence engine
objective: Create a deterministic execution intelligence engine that consumes DEV-22 implementation plans, converts planning decisions into bounded execution tasks, validates execution safety constraints, and produces explainable execution manifests for downstream River Development Agent workflows.
architecturalContext: River Development Agent roadmap Generation II
acceptanceCriteria: Execution engine consumes DEV-22 implementation plans instead of independently analyzing repositories.
Execution tasks are deterministic for identical implementation plans.
Execution decisions include explainable safety reasons.
Execution output remains bounded by approved scope.
Protected paths never enter execution manifests.
Commands requiring approval boundaries are identified.
Execution manifests represent ordered implementation actions.
Repository state remains unchanged during execution planning.
Focused tests, River Dev typechecking, and main-project typechecking pass.
